description.value: Bear Creek Outdoor Pool is a free seasonal outdoor public swimming pool operated by the City of Surrey, set within Bear Creek Park near 88 Avenue and King George Boulevard. The park setting offers a refreshing stop on a hot day for touring cyclists passing through Surrey. The pool is seasonal, typically operating from mid-May through early September.
